name: Asiaceratops
isnote: Neoceratopsian of uncertain position; the cited Wikipedia revision notes that the genus has often been considered a nomen dubium because of its limited holotype material.
sum: Asiaceratops is a ceratopsian from the Cenomanian Khodzhakul Formation of Uzbekistan, known from fragmentary material.
wsnote: No size given in the sources used.
holotype: CCMGE 9/12457 — Khodzhakul Formation, Uzbekistan (early Cenomanian, about 99 Ma).
material: Teeth and a phalanx referred in 1989; more skull elements and a partial humerus of individuals of different ages referred in 1995.
biology: Herbivore known from fragments; no behavioural data.
author: Nessov et al. 1989

sources.text: L. A. Nessov, L. F. Kaznyshkina, and G. O. Cherepanov. 1989. [Mesozoic ceratopsian dinosaurs and crocodiles of central Asia]. In Bogdanova and Khozatskii (eds.), Theoretical and Applied Aspects of Modern Palaeontology
